scaffold_reason: This record describes the explicit nonlinear MPC policy-table algorithm. The policy table, plant-specific feature map, validity envelope, runtime implementation, and target generation route are still project/implementation work.

authoring.description: Evaluate a precomputed nonlinear-MPC policy table over its declared state-feature domain and return the selected bounded command/trajectory together with table validity and region metadata. This is an algorithm, not a fallback or fusion strategy.

constraints: The selected state-feature map, table region data, command dimensions, and validity envelope are project/model-specific.
Policy-table evaluation must use fixed storage and return explicit validity metadata; the enclosing hybrid policy owns fallback selection.

notes: The project hybrid_algorithm declaration composes enmpc with nmpc_rti or other compatible members; that composition is not part of this module.
Supply the explicit policy data and validate table coverage, model feature mapping, and worst-case execution time for the selected target.
